title: SMS Marketing for Accountants & CPA Firms: 2027 Guide

facts.fact: According to the AICPA (2025), SMS open rates reach roughly 98% versus about 20% for email.
facts.quote: **SMS open rates reach roughly 98% versus about 20% for email** according to the AICPA (2025).

facts.fact: According to the Journal of Accountancy (2025), the average month-end close runs 5-6 business days.
facts.quote: **Average month-end close runs 5-6 business days** according to the Journal of Accountancy (2025).

facts.fact: According to Thomson Reuters 2025 Tax Season Pulse, firms hit peak preparer utilization above 90% during the final filing weeks.
facts.quote: According to Thomson Reuters 2025 Tax Season Pulse, firms hit peak preparer utilization above 90% during the final filing weeks

facts.fact: The guide targets firms with 5 to 75 staff and a defined client list of 200+ returns or recurring engagements.
facts.quote: **Firm size:** 5 to 75 staff with a defined client list of 200+ returns or recurring engagements.

facts.fact: The guide targets firms with $500K to $15M in annual fees.
The guide advises skipping SMS marketing software if a firm has fewer than 50 active clients.
facts.quote: Skip SMS marketing software if you have fewer than 50 active clients

facts.fact: The guide was published on June 1, 2026.
